name: EstrelaBet
desc: Brazilian online sports-betting and casino brand operated by EB Intermediacoes e Jogos S.A. (CNPJ 52.639.845/0001-25), ranked 8th by projected 2025 GGR in Brazil.
markets: Brazil (federally licensed fixed-odds operator until MP 1.394/2026)
distress: Brazil's Medida Provisória 1.394 of 25 Sep 2026 bans the operation, offer and advertising of fixed-odds betting nationwide and required operators to take sites and apps offline within ten days (planalto.gov.br); the estrelabet.bet.br domain now redirects to a government page. The MP is being challenged and must be converted into law to last (not confirmed on pages opened).
fit_rationale: EstrelaBet only sells to Brazilian bettors and, since September 2026, may neither operate nor advertise in Brazil; São Paulo GP is the only calendar match and betting is a crowded F1 category.
category_conflict: potential: several F1 teams hold betting-brand partners (crowded category)
outstanding: Owners of EB Intermediacoes e Jogos S.A. (CNPJ 52.639.845/0001-25); whether MP 1.394/2026 is upheld, converted or lapses; any non-Brazilian operations; current sponsorships (none checked on pages opened); sister brands ESTRELABET, VUPI.
